intent.summary: Makes the resolved bounds and coordinate space of a region available to descendant layout logic.
useWhen: Layout genuinely depends on measured available space
avoidWhen: Parent constraints, alignment, or proportional tracks can express the result declaratively

semantics.sizing: accepts parent proposal and reports resolved logical dimensions

attributes.name: coordinateSpace
attributes.description: Coordinate system in which geometry is reported.

attributes.name: spaceName
attributes.description: Identifier required when coordinateSpace is named.

constraints.message: Named coordinate spaces require a name.

notes: Measurement must not alter semantic order or accessibility identity.

mappings.strategy: Capture requested size and coordinate dependencies.
caveats: GeometryReader participates in SwiftUI proposal semantics.

mappings.strategy: Resolve geometry after layout and feed dependent values through a bounded adapter.
caveats: Event-driven measurement can create feedback loops.
